results.title: Mitchell Starc’s 10-Wicket haul: Joins Shane Warne and Nathan Lyon in elite Australian Test list
results.description: Mitchell Starc claimed 10 wickets as Australia thrashed Bangladesh by an innings and 51 runs in the second Test in Mackay to level the series 1-1. The haul took Starc to four 10-wicket Test hauls and 771 international wickets as he closed in on the all-time top 10.
